data.name: Fateema
data.gender_notes: Fateema is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Fateema is derived from the root 'fatah' meaning 'to open'. This name is associated with the one who opens the way or supports others. It is also used for the Prophet Aisha (RA) who is known as Ummul Mu'minin, 'Mother of the Believers'. The name Fateema carries the meaning “The Opener, Supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fateema usually hope their child will grow to embody the opener, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of Prophet Aisha (RA) and a symbol of strength, support, and wisdom in Islam.
data.etymology: Fateema belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Opener, Supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fateema total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فاطمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: فاطمة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ومعناه المرأة التي يغيب عنها الجنين، وهي كلمة مشتقة من الفعل العربي فطم، والذي يعني انقطاع الرضاعة، واسم فاطمة له أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث أن فاطمة الزهراء هي ابنة النبي محمد، وهي شخصية محترمة ومحبوبة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: فاطمہ
in_urdu.meaning: جس کے لیے بچہ بغیر دودھ پئے بڑا ہو جائے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فاطمہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہم ہے، یہ نام فاطمہ بنت محمد صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم سے منسوب ہے، جو نبی اکرم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی بیٹی تھیں، اور اسلام میں ان کی بہت عزت کی جاتی ہے

in_hindi.name: फ़ातिमा

in_pashto.name: فاطمه
